classification_reasons: Spec tightness: acceptance is measurable and every flagged concern is closed (panel #1 and #2, one [x]); panel #1 leaves the version half of data-conventions rule 4 for the owner at the merge, by design.

Blast radius: every module of app/data/ is rewritten and vision.py is deleted; the public frame contract loses three columns, BinanceBanError goes, um becomes futures, 1s goes, the cache subtree changes and completeness semantics change (quiet intervals are no longer gaps); scripts/measure_storage.py and two new external hosts. No risk-list item is hit (hits: {}).
Test coverage: the stub, fixtures and both data test modules are replaced (ratchet declared); about 45 tests are still to be written in step 9, so no existing test covers the new code.
attempted: Intent: mapped every intent bullet (source endpoints, vision removal, kept public names, BinanceBanError removed, CLI names and order, version 0.1.0, spot/futures with USDTM only and no mapping, interval set with 6h refused on futures, eight columns, close_time, turnover, futures volume note, completeness rules, kucoin/ subtree with binance-vision/ untouched, gw-ratelimit headers, the four open questions) to R1-R29 and the plan. Nothing nearby is solved instead. Not a quick intent.

Panel ledger, applied text: #1 is in R6 and plan steps 6-7; #2 is in R4, step 3 (min(max(reset,0)/1000, 60) as retry_after; with MAX_RETRY_AFTER = 60 and the '>' check, a capped reset never trips the long-wait stop), Proof test_429_without_retry_after_waits_for_the_reset, and the Risks line rewritten; #3 is in R22, the rest.py design (DownloadError caught in fetch_range, coverage kept, error attached), loader step 6 (settle every day of the range, then re-raise) and Proof test_days_fetched_before_a_download_error_stay_cached. The catch sits in fetch_range rather than _rest_pass as the decision worded it; the behaviour is the same. #4 is in R8 and step 10 (the grep skips only the two deprecation notes). The earlier spec/plan refusal-text mismatch is gone: both read 'KuCoin refused (HTTP <n>, code <c>): <msg>'. None is wrongly applied.

Spec and plan: every requirement has a plan step and a Proof test; the files listed in 'Files that change' cover every module the intent names plus the stub, fixtures and script; order of work is coherent (tests broken between steps 1 and 8 are declared).

Claims against today's code (working tree = merge base): loader.py (sync_days docstring promise lines 93-97, _rest_pass, _consecutive_ranges, _on_grid, _expected_ms, _worth_caching, _gap_reason, VISION_WORKERS, _vision_pass, _Cancelled, MISSING_IN_FILE/REST, threading/ThreadPoolExecutor imports), http.py (BinanceBanError, 418 branch, WEIGHT_HEADER, WEIGHT_THRESHOLD, WeightPacer, UNKNOWN_WEIGHT_WAIT = 1.0, _int_or_none, RETRY_DELAYS = (1,2,4), MAX_RETRY_AFTER = 60, sleep(max(backoff + jitter, retry_after))), rest.py (pacer_for, RestRange(frame, failure), fetch_range signature), schema.py (frame_from_csv, frame_from_rest, CSV_FIELDS, INT_COLUMNS, MICROSECOND_THRESHOLD, _to_milliseconds, _is_number, csv/io imports; TIME_COLUMNS kept, still used by measure_storage.py), params.py (MARKETS, SPOT_ONLY_INTERVALS, validate_symbol(symbol) with one argument; callers make_request, cache.cache_info, cache.clear_cache, measure_storage.cached_days, all named), cache.py (SUBTREE = 'binance-vision', file_name imported from vision.py, _DAY_FILE with [smhd] and no hyphen, symbol == directory check, cache_info validating the interval against 'spot'), __main__.py (SOURCE_LABELS, the MISSING_IN_FILE/REST gap lines, the total line), __init__.py (exports BinanceBanError). No module outside app/, tests/ and scripts/ imports app.data. CLAUDE.md lines 5-6, 30 and 36-37 are exactly the lines the plan hands the owner. docs/decisions/index.md does not exist. No contradiction found.

Measured endpoint rules vs plan (references/capture/summary.json): spot startAt inclusive, endAt exclusive, newest first, oclh order, seconds, 1500 newest kept; futures from and to inclusive (row_at_window_end true), oldest first, ohlc, ms, 200 oldest kept at 1/3/5; granularity 360 refused, 480/720/1440 accepted; every spot type accepted; spot 1day, 8hour and 12hour candles open on UTC-aligned boundaries, so _on_grid keeps them; unknown symbol spot 400100, futures 200000 with an empty list; seconds-valued from gets HTTP 400 code 300000. Plan tables, window rules and fixture names match.

Paging and completeness walk-through: spot backwards and futures forwards across a quiet stretch, a quiet whole day mid-range, a page ending mid-day, a refusal on page 2, a DownloadError on page 2, an unknown spot pair (covered span empty, every day carries KuCoin's message), an unknown futures symbol (NO_CANDLES), and a date before the first candle (BEFORE_FIRST). The covered span stays conservative: a partly covered day is MISSING and never cached. There are no duplicates and every page strictly moves the window. Non-blocking observations for the build and the owner: (a) the 'keeps newest' (spot) and 'keeps oldest' (futures) rules were measured only at 1m/3m/5m. If an endpoint kept the other end at a longer interval, the loop would close the window after one page and the day at the page boundary would be cached short, silently. The intent tells the design to rely on the measured table, so this is not a park, but the deploy-gate spot download (1h, 3 days, 72 rows) never pages spot. (b) If a whole range lies before the oldest candle, it reads NO_CANDLES ('check the symbol exists') rather than BEFORE_FIRST. (c) On the current day the futures loop may ask one window that starts in the future (already in Risks).

Proof: design phase, so no toolchain logs are expected. Each acceptance bullet of the intent and spec has a named Proof test; the fixtures are byte copies of the captured bodies; the stub enforces the measured window, order and page-cap rules, so a wrong window rule would fail the tests.

Blast radius: the diff touches only changes/0003-.../ (spec, plan, status, evidence). No guardrail file is touched and no risk-list item is hit. Callers (load_klines, cache_info/clear_cache, BinanceBanError importers, measure_storage.py) are in Risks. Old cache files are never read (new subtree, and read_day checks the schema). No new dependency; pyproject.toml and CI stay unchanged, consistent with CLAUDE.md's 'Things Claude gets wrong' line.

Policies: security-baseline is applied (envelope and row-shape checks, finite numbers, body bound, urlencode from validated values with fixed hosts, msg cleaned and cut to 200, code cut to 20, no '.' or '/' in symbols, path containment kept, offline tests). The owner accepts the checksum loss in the intent. data-conventions rule 4 is handled by panel #1. coding-standards, ux-and-brand (one-line errors, exit 2, copy in constants) and definition-of-done (ratchet declared, every deleted fixture named) are applied, not skipped.

Tests: a planned test could pass with a bug still present only if the stub shared the code's window rules. The stub is specified independently from the measured behaviour (spot [startAt,endAt) newest kept, futures [from,to] oldest kept), and the tests use page caps smaller than the range. The change type is feature, so rewriting tests is allowed. Retries, Retry-After, pacing, gaps, cache layout, atomic write, no-cache mode, current day, redirects, https only, datetime bounds and the CLI exit codes each keep a named test.
Skip markers: not applicable at design. The plan declares none.
Drive: not applicable at design (commands.drive empty).
